parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "with params as (
    select 1   as min_stuck_attempts,     -- порог зависших попыток после успеха
           100 as min_episode_eur         -- порог суммы эпизода (зависшие + отказы), EUR (PSP, 2026-10-14)
),

vip as (
    -- кто VIP: сегмент и флаги из agg_player_summary,
    select s.player_id,
           s.brand,
           max(s.risk_casino_segment) as risk_casino_segment
    from operator_ro_normcasino.agg_player_summary s
    where coalesce(s.is_test, false) = false
      and s.brand <> 'SBNORM'
      and s.risk_casino_segment in ('Good guys-X', 'VIP-Silver', 'VIP-Gold', 'VIP-Platinum')
    group by 1, 2
),

ev as (
    -- события депозитов VIP за четверо суток (D-3..D).
    -- Берём строку с transaction_status: на ней суммы и причина отказа.
    select p.player_id,
           p.brand,
           p.action_date,
           p.action_ts,
           p.transaction_status,
           p.order_id,
           p.send_amount,
           p.decline_reason_group_name,
           p.decline_reason_message,
           -- замер 2026-10-13: на строке с transaction_status живут
           -- provider / order_method / paygroup_name, а provider_name
           -- и payment_method_name лежат на второй строке события (status)
           p.order_method,
           p.paygroup_name,
           p.provider,
           p.payment_method_type,
           p.country
    from operator_ro_normcasino.f_payment p
    join vip v
      on  v.player_id = p.player_id
     and  v.brand     = p.brand
    where p.action_date >= date_add('day', -4, current_date)
      and p.action_date <  current_date
      and p.transaction_type = 'deposit'
      and coalesce(p.player_is_test, false) = false
      and p.transaction_status is not null
),

cur as (
    -- валюта лежит на второй строке события (со status)
    select p.order_id,
           max(p.amount_currency) as currency
    from operator_ro_normcasino.f_payment p
    where p.action_date >= date_add('day', -4, current_date)
      and p.action_date <  current_date
      and p.transaction_type = 'deposit'
      and p.amount_currency is not null
    group by 1
),

ev_eur as (
    -- суммы в EUR; через double, иначе decimal(38,18) переполняется
    select e.player_id,
           e.brand,
           e.action_date,
           e.action_ts,
           e.transaction_status,
           e.order_id,
           c.currency,
           e.send_amount,
           round(cast(e.send_amount as double) / nullif(cast(fx.inverted_rate as double), 0), 2) as amount_eur,
           e.decline_reason_group_name,
           e.decline_reason_message,
           e.order_method,
           e.paygroup_name,
           e.provider,
           e.payment_method_type,
           e.country
    from ev e
    left join cur c
           on c.order_id = e.order_id
    left join operator_ro_normcasino.d_fx_rate fx
           on  fx.from_currency  = c.currency
          and  fx.to_currency    = 'EUR'
          and  fx.exchange_date  = e.action_date
),

last_success as (
    -- момент последнего успешного депозита на конец каждого из двух окон
    select e.player_id,
           e.brand,
           max(if(e.transaction_status = 'Success'
                  and e.action_ts < cast(current_date as timestamp),
                  e.action_ts, null))                                   as success_ts_cur,
           max(if(e.transaction_status = 'Success'
                  and e.action_ts < cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) as timestamp),
                  e.action_ts, null))                                   as success_ts_prev
    from ev_eur e
    group by 1, 2
),

stuck as (
    -- зависшие попытки ПОСЛЕ последнего успеха, отдельно по двум окнам
    select e.player_id,
           e.brand,
           -- текущее окно: D-1 и D
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'New'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -2, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(current_date as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_cur, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  1, 0))                                                as pending_cnt_cur,
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'New'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -2, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(current_date as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_cur, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  e.amount_eur, 0))                                     as pending_eur_cur,
           -- отказы провайдера в том же окне после того же успеха — контекст
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'Fail'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -2, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(current_date as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_cur, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  1, 0))                                                as declined_cnt_cur,
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'Fail'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -2, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(current_date as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_cur, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  e.amount_eur, 0))                                     as declined_eur_cur,
           -- вчерашнее окно: D-2 и D-1, для дедупликации
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'New'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -3, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_prev, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  1, 0))                                                as pending_cnt_prev,
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'New'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -3, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_prev, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  e.amount_eur, 0))                                     as pending_eur_prev,
           sum(if(e.transaction_status = 'Fail'
                  and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -3, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts <  cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) as timestamp)
                  and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls.success_ts_prev, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),
                  e.amount_eur, 0))                                     as declined_eur_prev
    from ev_eur e
    join last_success ls
      on  ls.player_id = e.player_id
     and  ls.brand     = e.brand
    group by 1, 2
),

candidates as (
    -- условие алерта + дедупликация «условие замкнулось впервые»
    select s.player_id,
           s.brand,
           s.pending_cnt_cur,
           s.pending_eur_cur,
           s.declined_cnt_cur,
           s.declined_eur_cur
    from stuck s
    cross join params p

    where s.pending_cnt_cur >= p.min_stuck_attempts
      and coalesce(s.pending_eur_cur, 0)
        + coalesce(s.declined_eur_cur, 0) >= p.min_episode_eur
      and not (s.pending_cnt_prev >= p.min_stuck_attempts
               and coalesce(s.pending_eur_prev, 0)
                 + coalesce(s.declined_eur_prev, 0) >= p.min_episode_eur)
),

last_attempt as (
    -- последняя зависшая попытка: чем и через кого платил
    select la.player_id,
           la.brand,
           la.action_ts,
           la.currency,
           la.country,
           la.order_method,
           la.paygroup_name,
           la.provider,
           la.payment_method_type
    from (
        select e.player_id,
               e.brand,
               e.action_ts,
               e.currency,
               e.country,
               e.order_method,
               e.paygroup_name,
               e.provider,
               e.payment_method_type,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by e.player_id, e.brand
                   order by e.action_ts desc
               ) as rn
        from ev_eur e
        where e.transaction_status = 'New'
          and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -2, current_date) as timestamp)
          and e.action_ts <  cast(current_date as timestamp)
    ) la
    where la.rn = 1
),

last_decline as (
    select ld.player_id,
           ld.brand,
           ld.decline_reason_group_name,
           ld.decline_reason_message
    from (
        select e.player_id,
               e.brand,
               e.decline_reason_group_name,
               e.decline_reason_message,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by e.player_id, e.brand
                   order by e.action_ts desc
               ) as rn
        from ev_eur e
        join last_success ls2
          on  ls2.player_id = e.player_id
         and  ls2.brand     = e.brand
        where e.transaction_status = 'Fail'
          and e.action_ts >= cast(date_add('day', -2, current_date) as timestamp)
          and e.action_ts <  cast(current_date as timestamp)
          and e.action_ts >  coalesce(ls2.success_ts_cur, timestamp '1970-01-01 00:00:00')
    ) ld
    where ld.rn = 1
)

select c.player_id,
       c.brand,
       v.risk_casino_segment                                       as vip_segment,
       c.pending_cnt_cur                                           as pending_attempts,
       round(c.pending_eur_cur, 2)                                 as pending_amount_eur,
       a.action_ts                                                 as last_attempt_ts,
       date_diff('hour', a.action_ts, cast(current_timestamp as timestamp)) as hours_since_attempt,
       ls.success_ts_cur                                           as last_success_ts,
       a.currency                                                  as currency,
       a.country                                                   as country,
       a.order_method                                              as payment_method,
       a.paygroup_name                                             as paygroup,
       a.provider                                                  as provider,
       a.payment_method_type                                       as method_type,
       -- контекст: отказы провайдера после того же последнего успеха
       c.declined_cnt_cur                                          as declined_attempts,
       round(c.declined_eur_cur, 2)                                as declined_amount_eur,
       d.decline_reason_group_name                                 as decline_group,
       d.decline_reason_message                                    as decline_message
from candidates c
join vip v
  on  v.player_id = c.player_id
 and  v.brand     = c.brand
join last_attempt a
  on  a.player_id = c.player_id
 and  a.brand     = c.brand
join last_success ls
  on  ls.player_id = c.player_id
 and  ls.brand     = c.brand
left join last_decline d
  on  d.player_id = c.player_id
 and  d.brand     = c.brand
-- сортировка по всей сумме, которую игрок пытался завести
order by (coalesce(c.pending_eur_cur, 0) + coalesce(c.declined_eur_cur, 0)) desc, c.player_id",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-vip-deposit-alert-execution-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}

nodes.name: Execute Athena Query
nodes.notes: ClientRequestToken is derived from the execution id, so a retry of this node rejoins the same Athena query instead of starting a second one.

nodes.name: Poll Attempts Remaining?
nodes.notes: true -> wait and poll again; false -> give up after 120 polls (~10 min)

nodes.name: Stuck VIPs Found?
nodes.notes: true -> alert digest; false -> all-clear message. Zero candidates is a normal night, not a failure.

nodes.name: Build All-Clear Payload
nodes.notes: Disconnect this node from Stuck VIPs Found? to keep quiet nights silent.

nodes.name: HTTP Request — Send VIP Alert to Slack
nodes.notes: One POST per execution: either the alert digest or the all-clear message, both to slackWebhookUrl.
